title: Treanlaur, Maree, Oranmore, Co. Galway, H91WCD5
seoTitle: Treanlaur, Maree, Oranmore, Co. Galway, H91WCD5
description: O’Donnellan & Joyce are delighted to welcome to the market this stunning split-level detached residence, ideally situated at Treanlaur, Maree, just minutes from Oranmore.This exceptional property presents a wonderful opportunity to acquire a beautifully maintained detached home, set on an attractive site in a highly sought-after location.Offering generous proportions, excellent natural light and a versatile layout, this impressive home is sure to appeal to a wide range of buyers.The accommodation is bright and spacious throughout and includes a large kitchen and dining area, a generous sitting room, a family bathroom, and four well-proportioned bedrooms.The master bedroom benefits from its own en-suite, while a patio area provides an ideal space for outdoor dining and relaxation.Externally, the property offers excellent ancillary space, including a large car/boat shed and a block-built garage, providing substantial storage with potential for conversion, subject to the necessary planning permission.The property also benefits from ample private parking on the spacious tarmac driveway.Treanlaur enjoys an enviable location just minutes from the vibrant village of Oranmore, while also being within easy reach of Maree, Clarinbridge and Galway city centre.For those who enjoy the outdoors, Renville Park is just a five-minute drive away and offers beautiful woodland walks, a playground, the historic Rinville Castle and spectacular views across Galway Bay.Renville Sailing Club and Galway Bay Golf Resort, home to an 18-hole championship golf course, are also nearby and provide excellent recreational facilities.The Burren in north County Clare is approximately a 30-minute drive away, offering exceptional opportunities for walking, hiking and exploring the unique landscape.This superb home combines generous living accommodation, excellent outdoor space and a highly convenient location, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a quality family home within easy reach of Galway City.Properties can be viewed on our website www.odj.ie Keep up to-date with NEW PROPERTIES by registering your details on our
